_comment: DRAFT (updated 2026-09-15) — derived from visualization_studio_v15.html's TASKS records and addTask()/setsOf(), cross-checked against the REAL component_set schema at D:\work\cad\src\entities\component_set\v1\schemas\entitySchema.json. One variant_task row = one (variant, stage) pair, matching the wireframe's own 'TASKS — one record per variant per stage' comment. Fields the wireframe stores per-REQUEST, not per-task (reqBy/due/priority), are still denormalized here as priority/neededBy for list/filter convenience, but imageRequestId is the source of truth. metalTeamId/metalTeamCode/stoneTeamId/stoneTeamCode are denormalized from the matched component_set, following that same codebase's own id+code convention (metalTeamId+metalTeamCode, stoneTeamId+stoneTeamCode appear together on every component_set row) — added specifically because the real dedup key for 'is this image already being produced' is (metalTeamId, stoneTeamId, metalColourGroup, stoneColour), not componentSetId alone. 'Image sets' are intentionally NOT a field or sub-table — the wireframe's own setsOf() computes them as metalColourGroups.length x stoneColours.length, 'information only, no status of its own'. The activity timeline (wireframe's per-task 'log') is not duplicated into this JSONB blob either — it's already covered by the generic variant_task_history table every update() call writes. Status enum (Ready/Assigned/In progress/On hold/Completed — same set for all 3 stages since 2026-09-21, when rn's own Tool config/Keyshot/Photoshop sub-chain was removed per manager decision) is intentionally left unconstrained on the top-level `status` column, same as design_request's own status column. STILL OPEN, not reflected here yet: whether a cadRequestId/CAD-readiness field belongs on this schema — pending confirmation of whether D:\work\cad's existing cad_request entity (CAD_REQUESTED..CAD_COMPLETED lifecycle, keyed by baseDesignId) is the 'separate CAD process' gating Z-Brush task creation.

imageRequestId.description: The image_request this task belongs to. Wireframe field: reqNo.

baseDesignId.description: Denormalized reference to a base_design row in the (read-only) Merchandising/PIM pim_local database. Wireframe field: bdId.

componentSetId.description: The matched variant/geometry — PIM component_set.componentSetId. Wireframe field: vno.

metalTeamId.description: Denormalized from the matched component_set at the moment this variant is added, matching the id+code convention used throughout component_set/cad_request. Together with stoneTeamId + metalColourGroups + stoneColours, this is the real dedup key for 'is this image already being produced elsewhere' — see project memory's open dedup question.

metalTeamCode.description: Denormalized from the matched component_set (component_set.metalTeamCode), for display/reporting without a PIM round-trip.

stoneTeamId.description: Denormalized from the matched component_set at the moment this variant is added — see metalTeamId.

stoneTeamCode.description: Denormalized from the matched component_set (component_set.stoneTeamCode), for display/reporting without a PIM round-trip.

stage.description: Which of the 3 pipeline stages this task record is for.

dimensionalSelection.description: The DIMENSIONAL axis values that matched this componentSetId (axis id -> chosen value), e.g. {"size":"M","depth":"2.0mm"}. Wireframe field: sel. Axis ids vary per base design, so this is intentionally open-ended.

metalImageGroups.description: Only set on an rn-stage task (zb/obj never carry this — colour doesn't change geometry). One entry per distinct real imageText value from the metal master table, each listing which of the base design's metal options share it (e.g. Platinum/Silver/White Gold all sharing imageText 'white' collapse into one group, one image).

stoneImageGroups.description: Only set on an rn-stage task, same reasoning as metalImageGroups. One entry per distinct real imageCode from the stone master table, among the stone types this matched geometry covers (e.g. Natural Diamond and Lab Diamond sharing one imageCode collapse into one group, one image).

assignee.description: Person currently assigned to this task, if any.

priority.description: Denormalized from the owning image_request, for list/filter convenience.

neededBy.description: Denormalized from the owning image_request, for list/filter convenience.

status.description: Declared here (unconstrained, like design_request's own entitySchema.json) purely so validateSchema.js — which validates the WHOLE request body against this file, not just the details sub-object — doesn't reject a create/update payload that also carries the top-level `status` column value.

uploadedImages.description: Public URLs of images delivered for this task (render/rn stage only) — appended via POST /:id/images, never set directly through create/update (same 'append, don't merge-by-index' reasoning as image_request's requestedVariants). At least one is required before 'complete' can succeed for the rn stage — see RULES.md. These are already-uploaded URLs by the time they reach this repo: bff-for-app's imageUpload.service.js pre-hook (the same S3/GCS mechanism design_request's own referenceImages use) converts the raw image bytes to a cloud URL before this endpoint is ever called — Visualization never receives or stores raw file bytes.
